.github/workflows/release.yml.text:
name: Release

# Publication is an explicit operator action with no dispatch inputs.
# Semantic Release selects the version from main history. The unprotected
# preflight proves the dispatch selected the current main tip and that exact
# source already has successful push runs of ci.yml, p1r-qualification.yml,
# and commitlint.yml before the protected production job starts.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: release-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify-source:
    name: Verify exact live-main source proof
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      source-ci-workflow: ${{ steps.select-source-proof.outputs.source-ci-workflow }}
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Require current main with exact-source push proofs
        id: select-source-proof
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          DISPATCH_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          DISPATCH_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source_ci_workflow="ci.yml"

          if [ "$DISPATCH_REF" != "refs/heads/main" ]; then
            echo "Release must be dispatched from refs/heads/main." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ ! "$DISPATCH_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "The dispatch source must be an exact lowercase commit SHA." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          live_main_sha="$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/main" --jq '.object.sha')"
          if [[ ! "$live_main_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "The live main SHA could not be resolved safely." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$DISPATCH_SHA" != "$live_main_sha" ]; then
            echo "The dispatched source is no longer the live main tip." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          for required_workflow in ci.yml p1r-qualification.yml commitlint.yml; do
            source_runs="$(gh api --method GET \
              "repos/${REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/${required_workflow}/runs" \
              -f branch=main \
              -f event=push \
              -f head_sha="$DISPATCH_SHA" \
              -f status=success \
              -f per_page=100)"
            if ! printf '%s\n' "$source_runs" | jq -e --arg sha "$DISPATCH_SHA" '
              [.workflow_runs[] | select(
                .head_sha == $sha and
                .head_branch == "main" and
                .event == "push" and
                .status == "completed" and
                .conclusion == "success"
              )] | length > 0
            ' >/dev/null; then
              echo "No successful push ${required_workflow} run exists for the exact current main SHA." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          printf 'source-ci-workflow=%s\n' "$source_ci_workflow" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  release:
    name: Publish EventStore packages and container
    needs: verify-source
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    environment: production
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout approved Builds actions
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds
          ref: 22a578b576a515d2af214fe81859447fffc97981
          path: .hexalith/builds-execution
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Validate approved Builds execution identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C .hexalith/builds-execution rev-parse HEAD)" = "22a578b576a515d2af214fe81859447fffc97981"
      - name: Initialize root-declared submodules
        uses: ./.hexalith/builds-execution/Github/initialize-build
      - name: Initialize .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@a98b56852c35b8e3190ac28c8c2271da59106c68 # v6.0.0
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Cache NuGet packages
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.nuget/packages
          key: nuget-${{ hashFiles('Directory.Packages.props', 'global.json', 'references/Hexalith.Builds/Props/Directory.Packages.props') }}
          restore-keys: nuget-
      - name: Validate declared package count
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(jq -r '.packages | length' tools/release-packages.json)" = "14"
      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Verify npm dependency provenance and signatures
        run: npm audit signatures
      - name: Restore
        run: dotnet restore Hexalith.EventStore.slnx
      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build Hexalith.EventStore.slnx --no-restore --configuration Release -warnaserror
      - name: Set up arm64 emulation
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@96fe6ef7f33517b61c61be40b68a1882f3264fb8 # v4.2.0
        with:
          platforms: arm64
      - name: Prepare release container publisher
        uses: ./.hexalith/builds-execution/Github/publish-containers
        with:
          container-projects: |
            src/Hexalith.EventStore/Hexalith.EventStore.csproj|eventstore
          builds-execution-sha: 22a578b576a515d2af214fe81859447fffc97981
      - name: Resolve release publication freeze
        id: publish-gate
        shell: bash
        env:
          HEXALITH_RELEASE_PUBLISH_ENABLED: ${{ vars.HEXALITH_RELEASE_PUBLISH_ENABLED }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "${HEXALITH_RELEASE_PUBLISH_ENABLED-}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "publish-enabled=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Release publication is enabled for this repository."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "publish-enabled=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "::notice title=Release publication frozen::The repository variable HEXALITH_RELEASE_PUBLISH_ENABLED is not exactly 'true', so Semantic Release is skipped."
      - name: Revalidate current source before Semantic Release
        if: ${{ steps.publish-gate.outputs.publish-enabled == 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          DISPATCH_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          SOURCE_CI_WORKFLOW: ${{ needs.verify-source.outputs.source-ci-workflow }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$DISPATCH_SHA"
          test "$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/main" --jq '.object.sha')" = "$DISPATCH_SHA"
          for required_workflow in ci.yml p1r-qualification.yml commitlint.yml; do
            source_runs="$(gh api --method GET \
              "repos/${REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/${required_workflow}/runs" \
              -f branch=main -f event=push -f head_sha="$DISPATCH_SHA" \
              -f status=success -f per_page=100)"
            printf '%s\n' "$source_runs" | jq -e --arg sha "$DISPATCH_SHA" '
              [.workflow_runs[] | select(
                .head_sha == $sha and .head_branch == "main" and
                .event == "push" and .status == "completed" and
                .conclusion == "success"
              )] | length > 0
            ' >/dev/null
          done
      - name: Validate trusted publishing account
        if: ${{ steps.publish-gate.outputs.publish-enabled == 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          NUGET_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_USER: ${{ vars.NUGET_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_USER }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${NUGET_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_USER//[[:space:]]/}" ]; then
            echo "NUGET_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_USER must name the nuget.org policy creator." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Exchange GitHub OIDC for temporary NuGet key
        if: ${{ steps.publish-gate.outputs.publish-enabled == 'true' }}
        id: nuget-login
        uses: NuGet/login@8d196754b4036150537f80ac539e15c2f1028841 # v1.2.0
        with:
          user: ${{ vars.NUGET_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_USER }}
      - name: Semantic Release
        if: ${{ steps.publish-gate.outputs.publish-enabled == 'true' }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          NUGET_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_KEY: ${{ steps.nuget-login.outputs.NUGET_API_KEY }}
          HEXALITH_CONTAINER_PROJECTS: src/Hexalith.EventStore/Hexalith.EventStore.csproj|eventstore
          HEXALITH_ZOT_REGISTRY: ${{ vars.HEXALITH_ZOT_REGISTRY || 'registry.hexalith.com' }}
          HEXALITH_ZOT_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.HEXALITH_ZOT_USERNAME }}
          HEXALITH_ZOT_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HEXALITH_ZOT_API_KEY }}
          HEXALITH_BUILDS_EXECUTION_SHA: 22a578b576a515d2af214fe81859447fffc97981
          HEXALITH_RELEASE_ENVIRONMENT: production
          HEXALITH_RELEASE_SOURCE_BRANCH: main
          HEXALITH_RELEASE_SOURCE_CI_WORKFLOW: ${{ needs.verify-source.outputs.source-ci-workflow }}
          HEXALITH_RELEASE_PACKAGE_MANIFEST: tools/release-packages.json
          HEXALITH_RELEASE_EXPECTED_PACKAGE_COUNT: '14'
          HEXALITH_RELEASE_REQUIRE_AUTHORITY: 'false'
        run: npx semantic-release
      - name: Upload complete release evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .hexalith/release-evidence/**
          if-no-files-found: warn
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 30

.github/workflows/ci.yml.text:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  folded-snapshot-compatibility:
    name: ci / folded-snapshot-compatibility
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Initialize root-declared submodules
        run: git -c submodule.recurse=false submodule update --init

      - name: Initialize .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@a98b56852c35b8e3190ac28c8c2271da59106c68 # v6.0.0
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json

      - name: Verify published and current folded snapshot compatibility
        run: bash tools/folded-snapshot-compatibility/run.sh

  process-packages:
    name: ci / checkpointed process packages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Initialize root-declared submodules
        run: git -c submodule.recurse=false submodule update --init

      - name: Initialize .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@a98b56852c35b8e3190ac28c8c2271da59106c68 # v6.0.0
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json

      - name: Prove checkpointed process Release packages
        run: python3 scripts/verify-process-packages.py

  ci:
    uses: Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/.github/workflows/domain-ci.yml@main
    with:
      solution: Hexalith.EventStore.slnx
      build-timeout-minutes: 180
      test-platform: microsoft-testing-platform
      run-consumer-validation: true
      unit-test-projects: |
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Client.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Testing.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.SignalR.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Admin.Abstractions.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Admin.Cli.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Admin.Mcp.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Admin.Server.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Operations.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Admin.Server.Host.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Admin.UI.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.DomainService.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.QueryRouting.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.RestApi.Generators.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.LoadTests.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Sample.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Testing.Integration.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Server.Tests
        tests/Hexalith.EventStore.ProviderVerification.Tests

  contracts:
    name: ci / contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Initialize root-declared submodules
        run: git -c submodule.recurse=false submodule update --init

      - name: Initialize .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@a98b56852c35b8e3190ac28c8c2271da59106c68 # v6.0.0
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json

      - name: Run generated API smoke preflight regression
        run: bash scripts/tests/generated-api-smoke-preflight.test.sh

      - name: Install pinned OQ8 validator dependency
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "${RUNNER_TEMP}/oq8-python"
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/oq8-python/bin/python" -m pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary=:all: --requirement requirements-oq8.txt
          echo "${RUNNER_TEMP}/oq8-python/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Restore Contracts tests
        run: >-
          dotnet restore tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Tests.csproj
          -p:Configuration=Release
          -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=false

      - name: Build Contracts tests
        run: >-
          dotnet build tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Tests.csproj
          --no-restore
          --configuration Release
          -warnaserror
          -m:1
          -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=false

      - name: Run Contracts tests
        run: >-
          dotnet test tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Tests.csproj
          --no-build
          --configuration Release
          --filter-not-trait "Category=HeavyweightContainerPublish"
          --results-directory "TestResults/Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Tests"
          --report-xunit-trx
          --report-xunit-trx-filename Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Tests.trx
          --coverage
          --coverage-output-format cobertura
          --coverage-output coverage.cobertura.xml
          -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=false

      - name: Upload Contracts test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: contracts-test-results
          path: |
            TestResults/**/*.trx
            TestResults/**/coverage.cobertura.xml
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  semantic-release-governance:
    name: ci / semantic-release-governance
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up supported Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install locked npm dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Verify semantic-release GitHub success lifecycle
        run: node tests/Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Tests/Packaging/Fixtures/semantic-release-github-success.mjs

  tenants-source-mode:
    name: ci / tenants-source-mode
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      UseHexalithProjectReferences: 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Initialize root-declared submodules
        uses: Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/Github/initialize-build@main

      - name: Initialize .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@a98b56852c35b8e3190ac28c8c2271da59106c68 # v6.0.0
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json

      - name: Restore source-mode AppHost tests
        run: >-
          dotnet restore tests/Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests/Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests.csproj
          -p:Configuration=Debug
          -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=true

      - name: Build source-mode AppHost tests
        run: >-
          dotnet build tests/Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests/Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests.csproj
          --no-restore
          --configuration Debug
          -warnaserror
          -m:1
          -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=true

      - name: Verify Tenants source-mode topology guardrails
        run: >-
          dotnet test tests/Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests/Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests.csproj
          --no-build
          --configuration Debug
          --filter-class Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests.Configuration.TenantsApiLaunchSettingsTests
          --results-directory TestResults/Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests
          --report-xunit-trx
          --report-xunit-trx-filename Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests.trx
          -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=true

      - name: Upload Tenants source-mode test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: tenants-source-mode-test-results
          path: TestResults/Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests/**/*.trx
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

.github/workflows/p1r-qualification.yml.text:
name: P1R Qualification Preparation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  preparation-controls:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Initialize root-declared submodules
        run: git -c submodule.recurse=false submodule update --init

      - name: Verify bounded P1R preparation and process controls
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_p1r_qualification.py'

      # Synthetic fixtures and local process controls only: these contract checks keep tooling-only
      # scope and can never satisfy a published-package or operational qualification lane.
      - name: Verify P1R published qualification harness contracts
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_p1r_published_qualification.py'

      - name: Verify P1R published executor regressions
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_p1r_published_executor.py'

      - name: Initialize .NET for actual fixture registration checks
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@a98b56852c35b8e3190ac28c8c2271da59106c68 # v6.0.0
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json

      - name: Verify real Host and Domain snapshot registration
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_p1r_snapshot_registration.py'

      - name: Verify P1R private isolation controls
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_p1r_isolation.py'

      - name: Verify P1R complete isolation lifecycle controls
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_p1r_isolation_hardening.py'

      - name: Verify P1R isolation refusals under optimized Python
        run: python3 -O -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_p1r_isolation_hardening.py'

      - name: Checkout exact approved publication engine for regression controls
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds
          ref: 22a578b576a515d2af214fe81859447fffc97981
          fetch-depth: 1
          path: .hexalith/builds-publication-tests
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify one-use publication authority and same-run source controls
        env:
          HEXALITH_BUILDS_SOURCE: ${{ github.workspace }}/.hexalith/builds-publication-tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_release_publication_authority.py'

.github/workflows/commitlint.yml.text:
name: Commitlint

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: commitlint-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  commitlint:
    uses: Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/.github/workflows/commitlint.yml@main
    with:
      pull-request-title: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}

scripts/validate-publication-preflight.s.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

version="${1:-}"
phase="${2:-}"
builds_execution_sha="${HEXALITH_BUILDS_EXECUTION_SHA:-}"
registry="${HEXALITH_ZOT_REGISTRY:-registry.hexalith.com}"
source_sha="${GITHUB_SHA:-}"
source_branch="${HEXALITH_RELEASE_SOURCE_BRANCH:-}"
source_ci_workflow="${HEXALITH_RELEASE_SOURCE_CI_WORKFLOW:-}"
package_manifest="${HEXALITH_RELEASE_PACKAGE_MANIFEST:-}"
release_environment="${HEXALITH_RELEASE_ENVIRONMENT:-}"
reserved_version="${HEXALITH_RELEASE_RESERVED_VERSION:-}"
contract_directory="${HEXALITH_RELEASE_CONTRACT_DIRECTORY:-$PWD/.hexalith/release}"
publication_preflight="${HEXALITH_PUBLICATION_PREFLIGHT:-./.hexalith/release/publication_preflight.py}"
evidence_directory="${HEXALITH_RELEASE_EVIDENCE_DIRECTORY:-$PWD/.hexalith/release-evidence/$version/preflight}"
authority_issue_url="${HEXALITH_RELEASE_AUTHORITY_ISSUE_URL:-}"
authority_owner="${HEXALITH_RELEASE_AUTHORITY_OWNER:-}"
# Mirrors the shared publisher exactly. ${VAR-default} rather than ${VAR:-default}:
# an unset declaration keeps the guarded posture, while a set-but-empty value is a
# malformed declaration and must fail closed instead of picking a posture.
require_authority="${HEXALITH_RELEASE_REQUIRE_AUTHORITY-true}"

# Hexalith.EventStore publishes exactly these 14 NuGet packages. The count is declared
# here rather than counted from the manifest so that adding or dropping a package fails
# closed until the change is reviewed alongside tools/release-packages.json.
readonly expected_package_count=14
semver_pattern='^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(-([0-9A-Za-z-]+)(\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?$'

fail() {
  echo "[publication-preflight] $1" >&2
  exit 1
}

is_semver_without_numeric_padding() {
  local candidate="$1"
  local prerelease=""
  local identifier=""
  local -a identifiers=()
  [[ "$candidate" =~ $semver_pattern ]] || return 1
  [[ "$candidate" == *-* ]] || return 0
  prerelease="${candidate#*-}"
  IFS='.' read -r -a identifiers <<< "$prerelease"
  for identifier in "${identifiers[@]}"; do
    if [[ "$identifier" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$identifier" != "0" && "$identifier" == 0* ]]; then
      return 1
    fi
  done
  return 0
}

is_semver_without_numeric_padding "$version" ||
  fail "A semantic release version without build metadata or leading-zero numeric identifiers is required."
[[ "$phase" =~ ^(verify|publish)$ ]] ||
  fail "Publication phase must be verify or publish."
[[ "$builds_execution_sha" = "22a578b576a515d2af214fe81859447fffc97981" ]] ||
  fail "HEXALITH_BUILDS_EXECUTION_SHA must be the approved publisher commit."
[[ "$source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] ||
  fail "GITHUB_SHA must identify the exact workflow source commit."
[[ "$source_branch" = "main" ]] ||
  fail "HEXALITH_RELEASE_SOURCE_BRANCH must be exactly main."
[[ "$source_ci_workflow" = "ci.yml" ]] ||
  fail "HEXALITH_RELEASE_SOURCE_CI_WORKFLOW must be exactly ci.yml."
[[ "$package_manifest" = "tools/release-packages.json" ]] ||
  fail "HEXALITH_RELEASE_PACKAGE_MANIFEST must identify the authoritative manifest."
[[ "$release_environment" = "production" ]] ||
  fail "HEXALITH_RELEASE_ENVIRONMENT must identify the protected production environment."
[[ "$registry" = "registry.hexalith.com" ]] ||
  fail "The EventStore container registry must be registry.hexalith.com."
# Use ${VAR-} so set -u treats an unset value as empty without supplying a fallback.
# Unset and set-but-empty values therefore both compare unequal to the reviewed declaration.
[[ "${HEXALITH_RELEASE_EXPECTED_PACKAGE_COUNT-}" = "$expected_package_count" ]] ||
  fail "The workflow expected-package-count input must be exactly $expected_package_count."
[[ -x "$publication_preflight" ]] ||
  fail "The shared publication preflight is unavailable."
[[ -f "$package_manifest" ]] ||
  fail "The authoritative release package manifest is unavailable."
# Semantic Release selects the version. The production environment approves publication.
# A typed reservation or one-use issue authority is rejected so it cannot be ignored.
[[ "$require_authority" = "false" ]] ||
  fail "HEXALITH_RELEASE_REQUIRE_AUTHORITY must be exactly false. Semantic Release selects the version."
[[ -z "$reserved_version" && -z "$authority_issue_url" && -z "$authority_owner" ]] ||
  fail "Reservation and authority values must be empty. Semantic Release selects the version."

preflight_arguments=(
  --repository "Hexalith/Hexalith.EventStore"
  --version "$version"
  --source-sha "$source_sha"
  --source-branch "$source_branch"
  --source-ci-workflow "$source_ci_workflow"
  --container-repository "registry.hexalith.com/eventstore"
  --builds-execution-sha "$builds_execution_sha"
  --environment-name "$release_environment"
  --package-manifest "$package_manifest"
  --expected-package-count "$expected_package_count"
  --contract-directory "$contract_directory"
  --evidence-directory "$evidence_directory"
  --phase "$phase"
)
exec "$publication_preflight" "${preflight_arguments[@]}"
